newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan jails Chinese illegal immigrant for life.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan jails Chinese illegal immigrant for life.

text.p: A Taiwan district court sentenced a Chinese illegal immigrant to life in prison for abducting a state worker on a Taiwan-controlled island just off the mainland, a court official said on Thursday.
Sun Gang, 34, sneaked into a county government office on the island of Kinmen in July, seized a government employee and demanded a ransom of US$500,000 and a boat to return to the mainland.
Sun gave up after hours of negotiations with police and was arrested. No one was hurt in the incident.
Taiwan-held Kinmen, known as Jinmen on the mainland, is a heavily militarised frontier post about two km (1.5 miles) from China's southeastern Fujian province.
The guilty verdict and life sentence were handed down by the trial judge late on Wednesday, the court official said by telephone from Kinmen.
Life sentences are appealed automatically in Taiwan.
Growing numbers of mainland Chinese seeking high-paying jobs have crossed the Taiwan strait in recent years to enter Taiwan, political rival of China since a civil war split them in 1949.

Although Taipei and Beijing have no official ties and broke off semi-official contacts during an outbreak of political tension in mid-1995, they do have a Red Cross-brokered deal to repatriate illegal immigrants.
